tasks.short: Specify and supervise well modification programs

steps.what: Review verified well history, reservoir interpretation, integrity information and operational constraints in petroleum engineering software {OTHER} and {DOCS}.
Determine the well modification or stimulation specification, operating limitations and escalation conditions using engineering judgement and the existing review process.

Prepare the final program document in {DOCS}; configure native linked well identifiers, revision fields and reference tables, then check the complete specification, limitations, recipient and issue status against the engineering decisions.
outputs: checked final program document and issue destination

steps.what: Issue the checked final program document to the existing authorised operations team through {DOCS}, using its existing issue status and permissions.
inputs: checked final program document and issue destination

steps.what: Supervise actual program execution, discuss observed conditions with the operations team and make or escalate engineering decisions under the existing operational authority.
Write and check the actual supervision findings and decisions in the existing program record in {DOCS}.
Save the checked final supervision entry in {DOCS}.

tasks.design: Configure native well identifiers and controlled reference tables in {DOCS}. Engineering specification and live supervision remain human; only repeated final-document assembly becomes shorter.
tasks.previous_blocker: Program documents can repeatedly copy well references and revision details.
tasks.enabler_now: Native controlled fields can reuse verified references without choosing treatment methods.
tasks.still_hard: Well uncertainty, integrity and changing execution conditions require engineering judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when observed conditions invalidate the proposed program.

ambition.what: No automatic treatment or well-control decisions.

tasks.altitude: Less reference-table assembly; technical and supervisory responsibility stays unchanged.

reach.learn: Make assumptions and escalation conditions traceable.

evidence.claim: Controlled document fields can reuse well and revision references without deciding petroleum engineering specifications.

assumptions: Boundary is the engineer's specification, internal issue, participation in supervision and actual supervision entry. Crew execution is outside the focal denominator and gains no saving. Shares are illustrative.

The engineer verifies well ID, source revision, operational constraints and integrity references in s1, writes the actual specification in s2 and supplies its issue destination in s3. Missing information is manually clarified; its work is retained. Supervisory findings arise only from actual execution in s5, never from the planned schedule.

Try native document configuration first. Engineering choices, discussions, live supervision and actual findings writing retain full time. No control-system command, automatic instruction or new release authority is introduced.

s3 and s6 ordinary checks occur after their final documents exist and bind the requested exact-version issue and save gates. Edits invalidate them; these are not additional self-approval meetings. Existing independent reviews remain required where applicable. Both one-share actions retain full time.
research_questions: Which repeated reference fields can native document controls populate without changing technical content?

already_counted.description: Review assembled program content and final issue details.

incremental.description: Maintain controlled well-reference fields and revision checks.

approvals.approved_version: Final program and destination checked at the end of s3
Final supervision entry checked at the end of s6

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Native document fields remove 30% of the 14-hour final assembly share: 4.2 gross hours less 1 upkeep. Zero if already configured. Specification, supervision, findings capture, issue and save retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Monitor actual production and plan rework

steps.what: Inspect the actual production records and downtime annotations in the production monitoring system {OTHER}, checking meter validity, well identity, units and missing periods.

Build rate trends and downtime comparisons currently assembled in {SPREADSHEET}; configure native production views in the production monitoring system {OTHER} to use explicit periods, units and quality flags, then check the resulting comparisons.
Interpret production changes with the actual well history and staff explanations, distinguish measurement problems from operational causes and determine whether and how rework should be proposed.
Document the actual rework proposal in {DOCS}; use native links to the checked trend figures, then check the complete plan, assumptions and unresolved questions against the engineering decision.
Save the checked final rework plan draft in {DOCS} with its draft status.

tasks.design: Configure native production trend views in the production monitoring system {OTHER} and link verified figures into {DOCS}. Keep quality checks, causal interpretation and rework choices with the engineer.
tasks.previous_blocker: Engineers can manually rebuild period comparisons and paste figures into rework plans.
tasks.enabler_now: Native trend views and linked figures can reuse actual production records.
tasks.still_hard: A production decline does not by itself establish a cause or justify rework.
tasks.human_edge: Separate reservoir behaviour, downtime and bad measurement before choosing a response.

ambition.what: Reassess a rework proposal after a new verified production period rather than rebuilding the comparison manually.

tasks.altitude: Less trend preparation, with the same engineering decision rights.

evidence.claim: Native production views can aggregate rates and display quality and downtime annotations from explicit source records.

assumptions: Boundary is monitoring and planning through a stored rework draft, not specification and supervision of the approved intervention in task 3582. The plan is an input there, not duplicated program labour. Shares are scenarios.

Existing authorised production records supply well ID, period start/end, phase/rate value, unit, measured duration, downtime annotation and quality flag. Operations staff and existing meters are the source producers; this task adds no instrumentation or free field capture. The engineer verifies and manually resolves gaps in s1. If exports or native views lack those fields, retain manual comparisons.

Native configuration precedes code. Only repeated trend assembly and linked-figure preparation lose time. Current automatic telemetry runtime is excluded from savings, and the engineer's causal interpretation remains unchanged.

The ordinary final check in s4 binds the complete draft for the requested s5 save gate; edits require rechecking. No extra approval process is added and the one-share save is fully retained. No rework is executed by this design.
research_questions: Can native views preserve shut-in periods and invalid meter readings without treating them as productive zeroes?

already_counted.description: Check trend construction and completed linked plan.

incremental.description: Maintain trend-period, unit and document-link configuration.

approvals.approved_version: Final rework plan draft checked at the end of s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Trend assembly saves 15 hours and figure reuse saves 2.8, less 3 upkeep: 14.8 net. Zero if native comparisons and links already exist. Data verification, engineering decisions and save retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain actual drilling and production records

steps.what: Read the actual drilling reports and production entries, match well and reporting period and clarify incomplete or conflicting source entries with the responsible staff.

Enter and normalise the operational record in petroleum operations records software {OTHER}; configure its native import mapping for already structured source fields, retaining manual entry and verification for narrative or missing fields.

Reconcile the completed operational record with the sources in petroleum operations records software {OTHER}; use native duplicate, unit and period checks, inspect all exceptions and verify the final facts before save.
Save the checked final operational record and its source references in petroleum operations records software {OTHER}.

tasks.design: Configure native structured imports and record checks in petroleum operations records software {OTHER}. Keep source clarification, narrative entry and final factual review with the engineer.
tasks.previous_blocker: Operational facts can be re-entered and reconciled from separate drilling and production reports.
tasks.enabler_now: Native field mapping and explicit duplicate, unit and period rules can reduce repeated entry and mechanical checking.
tasks.still_hard: Conflicting field reports and ambiguous events require clarification with the source producer.
tasks.human_edge: Keep an unresolved discrepancy visible instead of silently turning it into a clean record.

ambition.what: No automatic operational completion or production claims.

tasks.altitude: Less repeated record entry; responsibility for actual operational facts remains.

reach.task: Trace operational records used in reporting
reach.learn: Preserve source, unit and event provenance.

evidence.claim: Operations records tools can map structured source fields and validate duplicates, units and reporting periods without interpreting unrecorded events.

assumptions: Boundary is maintaining the operational record from existing actual source reports through save. Initial field reporting and meter acquisition already happen outside this task and are unchanged; this engineer's clarification and entry are included. Shares are illustrative.

Drilling and production staff produce source report ID/version, well ID, actual event date and period, depth and unit where applicable, actual activity/status, production quantity/rate and unit, downtime and uncertainty. The engineer verifies sources in s1. Native import accepts only mapped fields; unstructured reports, missing units and unmatched wells use counted manual entry in s2. No model guesses missing events.

Try native import and validation before custom integration. Only manual repeated entry and mechanical comparisons lose time. Already automated data collection or import runtime earns no saving; an already integrated site gets zero.

s3's ordinary completed-record check supplies the requested exact-version s4 commit gate without an extra approval stage. Changes invalidate it. Save has one fully retained share. Supervision notes in task 3582 are existing source records here, not recreated or credited twice.
unknowns: Source report structure and actual re-entry burden
research_questions: Which drilling and production fields already import automatically, and which are still re-entered?

already_counted.description: Review imported fields, manually enter exceptions and reconcile final records.

incremental.description: Maintain source mappings, unit rules and duplicate checks.

approvals.approved_version: Final operational record checked at the end of s3

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Native field mapping saves 21 hours and mechanical checking 6.8, less 3 upkeep: 24.8 net. Zero for an already integrated record workflow. Source clarification and save remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Recommend well placement and supplementary production processes

steps.what: Verify geological interpretations, well performance, reservoir model revisions and spatial constraints in reservoir modelling software {OTHER}, preserving uncertainty and coordinate references.

Prepare and compare engineer-selected placement and supplementary-process cases in reservoir modelling software {OTHER}; configure native case templates and comparison tables, checking each case's actual inputs and result validity.
outputs: checked placement and process case comparisons

steps.what: Interpret the case comparisons, select a recommendation and explain sensitivity to reservoir uncertainty, operational feasibility and production assumptions.
inputs: checked placement and process case comparisons

steps.what: Prepare the recommendation report in {DOCS}; use native linked case figures and references, then check its completed conclusions, limitations, source versions and intended recipient against the engineer's analysis.
inputs: checked placement and process case comparisons
outputs: checked final placement report and recipient

steps.what: Save the checked final placement report in {DOCS}.
inputs: checked final placement report and recipient

steps.what: Send the checked final placement report to the existing internal review recipient through {EMAIL}.
inputs: checked final placement report and recipient

tasks.design: Configure native candidate-case templates and comparison tables in reservoir modelling software {OTHER}, with linked results in {DOCS}. The engineer selects the cases, interprets uncertainty and checks the final recommendation before its separate save and send.
tasks.previous_blocker: Case input setup, result comparison and report figures may be rebuilt for each candidate.
tasks.enabler_now: Native case templates and linked outputs reuse explicit modelling inputs without choosing the preferred well location.
tasks.still_hard: Reservoir uncertainty and model limitations dominate the engineering recommendation.
tasks.human_edge: Reject an attractive numerical result that depends on unsupported geological assumptions.

ambition.what: Compare an additional engineer-selected placement alternative when uncertainty could change the recommendation.

tasks.altitude: Less repeated case setup and figure copying; recommendation authority remains unchanged.

reach.learn: Keep model scenarios tied to uncertain geological evidence.

evidence.claim: Reservoir modelling tools can reuse case inputs and compare explicit scenario outputs without establishing that the reservoir interpretation is correct.

assumptions: Boundary is placement and supplementary-process analysis through its recommendation delivery, not authorising drilling or executing interventions. Production records in task 3586 are existing inputs; no repeated maintenance credit. Shares are scenarios.

Source specialists supply geological model/version, coordinate system, well trajectories, measured performance periods/units and uncertainty ranges. The engineer verifies them in s1 and defines candidate locations, process choices and parameter sets at the start of s2; this selection and all manual input clarification are counted. Native templates copy only named fields; missing inputs stop the case for manual resolution.

Native case configuration precedes code. Solver runtime already occurs and earns no labour saving. Only repeated case setup, comparison layout and report-figure assembly lose time; case selection, substantive result checking and recommendation judgement remain.

The ordinary completed-report check in s4 binds its final file and recipient for both s5 and s6. Edits require rechecking; no extra self-approval meeting is added. Save and send each have one fully retained share. Additional alternatives are conditional demand, not baseline labour saving.
research_questions: Can native case comparisons retain parameter and model provenance for every reported result?

already_counted.description: Select and check configured cases and review the completed linked report.

incremental.description: Maintain case templates, comparison fields and report links.

approvals.approved_version: Final placement report checked at the end of s4
Same final placement report and recipient checked at the end of s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Native case setup saves 10 hours and linked report figures 3.6, less 2 upkeep: 11.6 net. Zero if already configured. Interpretation, source verification, save and send retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Petroleum engineers retain operational and subsurface judgement while native records, comparison views and controlled documents reduce repeated preparation.
reach: Discuss model uncertainty with geological engineers
Make program limitations traceable for health and safety engineers
role.ambitious_version: Compare justified engineering alternatives with explicit uncertainty and unchanged operational authority.
